text:
Predicates:
LocatedIn(x, y) ::: x is located in y.
Name(x, y) ::: x is named after y.
Bulgaria(y) ::: y is a place in Bulgaria.
Antarctica(y) ::: y is part of Antarctica.
Cove(x) ::: x is a cove.
Settlement(x) ::: x is a settlement.
SouthShetlandIslands(x) ::: x is part of the South Shetland Islands.
SnowIsland(x) ::: x is Snow Island.
GreenwichIsland(x) ::: x is Greenwich Island.
DeceptionIsland(x) ::: x is Deception Island.
SpecialRegion(x) ::: x is a special region.
PartOf(x, y) ::: x is part of y.
A(x) ::: x is a specific location.
B(x) ::: x is a specific location.
C(x) ::: x is a specific location.

Premises:
BarutinCove ::: Barutin Cove is named after the Bulgarian settlement of Barutin.
LocatedIn(BarutinCove, SnowIsland) ::: Barutin Cove is on the southwest coast of Snow Island.
SnowIsland ::: Snow Island is part of the South Shetland Islands.
SouthShetlandIslands ::: South Shetland Islands include Snow Island, Greenwich Island, and Deception Island.
SouthShettlandIslands ::: South Shetland Islands are considered part of Antarctica.
A(x) ∧ B(y) ∧ C(z) → LocatedIn(x, z) ::: If A is in B and B in C, then A is in C.

Conclusion:
∃x ∃y (Name(x, y) ∧ Cove(x) ∧ PartOf(y, Bulgaria) ∧ PartOf(x, Antarctica)) ::: There is at least one cove in Antarctica named after a place in Bulgaria.
